body:
Fixes #31

The main Pages run failed at `CreateArtifact: ENOTFOUND` after its browser assertions passed. Evidence and Pages uploads now share the official artifact SDK with three bounded attempts for transient transport/429/5xx failures. Permanent failures, empty evidence and exhausted retries fail. A partial-success retry reconciles the existing artifact before replacement, and Pages retains the official tar-in-ZIP format.

The complete audit also found CI false greens and platform-only warnings. The PR:

- Fixes native ESM imports throughout the settings configuration graph, extracts the oversized collector helper, and avoids unsupported jsdom canvas noise while retaining real-browser coverage.
- Adds complete terminal job coverage, fresh-merge and relevant-change checks, Python/Ruff/ShellCheck, actionlint, zizmor, full CodeQL scans in all three languages, documentation checks, scheduled lock audits and early Pages preflight. Read jobs cancel independently; deployments serialize. Deploy verification checks the commit, actual JavaScript and PDF signature.
- Resolves the macOS npm advisory through a reviewed approval for **fsevents@2.3.3** only. The all-platform lockfile test requires a new review for another version. A narrow, tested glob override removes the SDK's deprecated transitive dependency warning.
- Fixes all ten full-scan CodeQL findings: two regex hangs, regex HTML extraction/text stripping, incomplete package-name encoding, inline script JSON boundaries, both hostname matchers and dynamic test-label escaping. HTML parsing uses the already locked parse5; all 63 archived post bodies retain their text apart from documented browser-equivalent NUL normalization. Existing data and media are unchanged.
- Makes each security job inspect its actual SARIF results after analysis. The prior workflow passed while the separate CodeQL check failed; findings, missing/malformed reports and unsuccessful tool invocations now fail the workflow as well. All default queries, maintained-source coverage and the independent check remain enabled. Full scans also avoid CodeQL's 300-file compare limit for this evidence-heavy PR.

All seven browser suites, three engines, the exact 4,131-card gallery case, compositor captures and all 120 PDF checks remain enabled. This private website has no package/container publishing target; Pages remains its release mechanism. Development requires Node 24, matching CI and the artifact SDK. Source archives without Git metadata still build.

Validation: **833 tests in 55 suites pass locally**, plus production build, lint/format/secret/file limits, Python/Ruff/ShellCheck, pinned actionlint, both zizmor modes and a zero-vulnerability committed-lock audit. Reproductions fail before each fix, including bounded child-process probes for both hangs, actual npm warning reproduction, SDK DNS recovery, deployment false positives and nested archived-config discovery. The real ten-finding SARIF report fails the new gate; a real clean Python report passes. Local six browser suites and all 120 PDFs passed; a bounded local gallery probe hit its memory guard, while the complete gallery passed on every hosted engine. [Hosted implementation run 40681082933](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/actions/runs/40681082933) passed at `67ca6ef`: all 833 tests, every browser suite on every engine, all 120 PDFs and all real uploads. The independent CodeQL check passes; each language reports zero findings and the complete PR-merge alert list is empty. The complete raw log has no warnings or errors; its three annotations are informational notices. **Final head `2ed5847` also passes [run 40682827053](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/actions/runs/40682827053): all 14 required checks succeed, deployment is deliberately skipped for the PR, all 833 tests and 120 PDFs pass, all three browser engines upload their evidence, and the real Pages upload succeeds. The independent CodeQL check passes with zero open PR-merge alerts. Complete final raw logs contain no warnings or errors; all annotations are informational notices. The working tree is clean and current main is an ancestor.**

The [collected investigation](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/tree/issue-31-ec772c60ce96/dev/log/issues/31/pulls/32) includes every requirement and solution plan, all 17 guide principles, all **603 template paths** classified/hashed, original template snapshots, complete CI logs, before/after regressions, [verification](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-31-ec772c60ce96/dev/log/issues/31/pulls/32/VERIFICATION.md), and the [ten-alert security inventory](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-31-ec772c60ce96/dev/log/issues/31/pulls/32/SECURITY.md). Root-only lint/hook configuration keeps archived template configuration from executing; archived source hashes remain intact.

Shared defects reported upstream: artifact transport [JS #264](https://github.com/link-foundation/js-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/264) / [Python #120](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/120); CodeQL diff limit [JS #265](https://github.com/link-foundation/js-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/265) / [Python #121](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/121); security outcome gate [JS #266](https://github.com/link-foundation/js-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/266) / [Python #122](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/122). These reports do not block the website fixes.
title: Fix Pages uploads, CI validation gaps, and CodeQL findings
